name: Dev credentials can reach the Templates page
description:
Objective: Dev credentials can reach the Templates page.
Preconditions: Open Notification portal dev env with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Notification portal dev env.
2. Dev credentials can reach the Templates page.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The Templates page must be reachable after configured app login.
